<!-- pr-reviewer: 68feacb29de439f6aaf73d96537f6e239c9610ed -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- The executable paths come from Cargo JSON artifacts. The gate does not search the target directory.
- The tests check the package environment, working directory, failure result, log format, and fallback to Cargo.
- The PR has its decision record and `Process change: yes`. It does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- Parent PR #2788 is merged. This PR merges cleanly with current main.

Results on the local trial merge with upstream/main `cced2e6fde64825399ac1c9eb42c8aed15f27b9a`:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; selected the xtask tests.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed in 184 seconds. The unit suite passed all 206 tests.
- Integration suites passed: `catalog` (4), `docs_images` (4), `example_line_endings` (1), `merge_ready_skill` (3), `merge_review` (6), `post_merge_concurrency` (1), and `review_artifacts` (3).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The first build stopped after it made no progress with the shared sccache service. The completed checks ran with the wrapper disabled.

Extra suites run:
- No fixture directory or importer changed. The extra kernel and importer suites do not apply.
- A temporary fixture with `compile_error!` failed its batch prebuild as expected. The step log kept the diagnostic and source location. The fixture was removed.

Requested before merge: none.

Safety and scope:
- This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
- No goldens or UI files changed. No heavy lane applies.
- No mutations were run. This is not a safety-tier review, and the review did not change the PR code.
- A full batch gate and Windows or Linux runs were not repeated. The gate skill text still needs the update that the PR body records.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge note: this PR merges now at head `68feacb29de439f6aaf73d96537f6e239c9610ed`.

- Class: no refresh. The head is the reviewed head, and it merges cleanly with `main`.
- Review: the `pr-reviewer` marker of mkinney's review agent on this head. A collaborator set `merge-ready`.
- This is a process PR (`Process change: yes`). The merging session opens the `PROCESS_VERSION` PR after this merge and comments on #681.
